reasonMin: Give a reason (5 characters or more).

queue.title: Pharmacy
queue.description: Prescriptions to give at this facility, oldest first.

empty.ready: Nothing waiting. New prescriptions appear when a doctor signs.
empty.queried: No open question to a doctor.

queue.noMatchBody: Check the spelling, or search by prescription number or ticket.

identity.title: Who is at the counter?
identity.hint: Confirm the person before you give anything.
identity.ticket_name_dob: Ticket, name and date of birth
identity.ticket_name_dobHint: You checked all three with the patient.
identity.verification_codeHint: The patient shows the code on their phone or paper.
identity.codeRequired: Type the code the patient shows.
identity.required: Confirm who the patient is first.

dispense.title: Give medicines
dispense.noSubstitute: No product with the same ingredient and strength in the catalogue.
dispense.controlled: I checked the rules for controlled medicines
dispense.controlledHint: Identity, quantity and the register entry.
dispense.chooseOne: Choose what you give for at least one medicine.
dispense.signedBody: The patient sees this in My medicines. Print the labels next.
dispense.reloaded: Someone changed this prescription meanwhile. It was reloaded: check it and sign again.
dispense.nothingOpen: Nothing left to give on this prescription.
dispense.substituteQuantityHint: Leave empty to give all {{count}} left.

query.title: Question to the doctor
query.hint: The doctor answers with an addendum. Never change a medicine yourself.
query.answered: The doctor answered with an addendum.
query.answeredWait: Answered. The pharmacist will close the question.
query.bodyHint: Saved as a signed addendum on this consultation.

availability.title: Medicine availability
availability.description: Switch off what is out of stock. Doctors then see "Not in stock here" when they prescribe.
availability.followsStock: Follows its stock count. Receive or adjust it on the Stock page.

labels.title: Dosing labels
labels.description: One label per medicine given, 62 mm wide.
labels.none: No labels yet: nothing has been given.

prescription.title: Prescription
prescription.drugHint: Type 2 letters or more of the name.
prescription.offCatalogue: "{{name}}" is not in the catalogue. The pharmacist will see it as typed.
prescription.quantityHint_one: {{count}} from dose, how often and days
prescription.quantityHint_other: {{count}} from dose, how often and days
prescription.substitutionHint: Only with the same ingredient and strength.
prescription.cancelConsequences: The pharmacy will not give it. The patient sees it as cancelled.
prescription.changeConsequences: This one is cancelled with your reason, then you add the new one.

today.title: Pharmacy counter
today.nothing: No prescription waits. New ones appear here as doctors sign.
today.lowStock_one: Low on stock ({{count}} batch expiring soon)
today.lowStock_other: Low on stock ({{count}} batches expiring soon)

history.title: Dispensing history
history.intro: What was given at this pharmacy, by whom and when. Open a line for the full prescription.

verify.title: Verify a prescription
verify.intro: A prescription from another facility: check the code, then open the medicines with the patient's date of birth.
verify.codeHint: Printed under the QR code on the prescription
verify.notFound: No document with this code. Check it with the patient.
verify.author: Prescriber
verify.bornHint: Opens the medicines; protects the patient's privacy.
verify.bornWrong: The date of birth does not match.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: What is on the shelf, batch by batch. Giving medicines takes the earliest expiry first.
stock.noneBody: Receive a batch to start counting a medicine. Others keep the switch on Medicine availability.
stock.noneShort: Nothing is low or out of stock.
stock.expiringNone: No batch expires in the next 60 days.
stock.expiringIntro: Batches with units left that expire within 60 days, expired ones first. Give these first, or take expired ones off the shelf.

receive.title: Receive stock
receive.description: One batch at a time, as printed on the box.
receive.expiryPast: This batch has already expired. Don't put it on the shelf.
receive.quantityRequired: Give the number of units, 1 or more.
receive.quantityHint: Tablets, capsules, bottles: the unit you give.

stock.thresholdHint: "Low stock" below this number. 0 turns it off.
stock.thresholdInvalid: Give a whole number, 0 or more.
stock.detailIntro: Batches on the shelf and the latest movements.
stock.noBatches: No units left. Receive a batch to restock.
stock.expiredToRemove_one: {{count}} expired unit is still on the shelf. Adjust its batch with the reason Expired.
stock.expiredToRemove_other: {{count}} expired units are still on the shelf. Adjust their batch with the reason Expired.

adjust.title: Adjust batch {{batch}}
adjust.description_one: {{count}} unit in this batch now. Every change is recorded with your name.
adjust.description_other: {{count}} units in this batch now. Every change is recorded with your name.
adjust.countedHint: Count the batch on the shelf and type the number.
adjust.countedRequired: Type the number you counted, 0 or more.
adjust.noChange: That is the number already recorded.
